title: Raspberry Lemon Mini Muffins with Lemon Drizzle
changes_from_base: Small zesty muffins made in a mini tin with a whole raspberry pressed into each, finished with a lemon icing drizzle.
summary: Bite-sized lemon muffins with a raspberry in the centre and a sharp lemon drizzle.

ingredients.item: lemon, finely grated zest and 1 tsp juice
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and grease the 24 holes of the mini tin.

steps.title: Zest
steps.text: Put the sugar in a large bowl and rub in the lemon zest with your fingertips until it smells strongly of lemon.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk the melted butter into the lemon sugar for 1 min, then whisk in the egg and the milk. Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until just combined, then the 1 tsp lemon juice.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spoon the batter into the holes until three-quarters full and press one raspberry, hollow side down, into each.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 12-15 min, until golden and a cocktail stick comes out clean. Leave 15 min, then ease them out of the tin.

steps.title: Drizzle
steps.text: Stir the icing sugar with the lemon juice to a thick, pourable icing and drizzle it over the cooled muffins.

tips: The most common mistake is overfilling the tiny holes; three-quarters full stops them merging on top.
Frozen raspberries work; use them straight from the freezer.
Add the drizzle only when they are cold or it will melt away.
storage: Keep in one layer in an airtight box for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
